title: Japan Travel Planner
summary: A responsive Japan itinerary planner with account-based trip editing, reusable templates, yen cost summaries, print output, and English/Japanese interface support.
description: A WGU capstone project that developed into a full-stack travel-planning application. The original application iteration was completed without AI according to Tyler; later contribution boundaries need confirmation.
distinction: Originated as a manually completed school project, per Tyler's statement; later revisions add public templates, localization, mobile and dark-theme views, and deployment support.
currentState: Implemented at inspected revision; current live availability and backend test result were not verified.
previewCondition: Use only after public-use and data-provenance review; otherwise use no image.

blocks.summary: Tyler states the first application iteration was a manually completed school project; distinguish subsequent changes.
Trip items, cost and reusable plans are organized in one itinerary.

blocks.visibleSummary: Trips combine date or location grouping, search, filters, JPY cost status and printable output.

blocks.summary: The itinerary UI supports narrow screens and a dark theme.

blocks.visibleSummary: The React client sends session-based requests to a Spring API, which stores account-scoped data in PostgreSQL.

blocks.summary: Interface resources and curated public templates support English and Japanese; user content remains as entered.
Frontend lint, 72 tests and build passed locally; backend and live deployment were not checked.

originalIteration.source: Tyler's direct statement in discovery request
